column1: While many diseases that affect humans have been eradicated due to improvements in vaccinations and the availability of healthcare, there are still areas around the world where certain health issues are more prevalent.
column2: 随着疫苗接种的改进和医疗服务的普及，许多危害人类的疾病已被根除。尽管如此，世界上仍有一些地区，某些健康问题在当地尤其普遍。
column5: availability of healthcare|医疗服务的可获得性

column1: In a world that is far more globalised than ever before, people come into contact with one another through travel and living closer and closer to each other.
column2: 如今世界的全球化程度远超以往。人们出门旅行，彼此也住得越来越近，因而有了更多相互接触的机会。
column4: than ever before|比以往任何时候

column1: As a result, super-viruses and other infections resistant to antibiotics are becoming more and more common.
column2: 结果，超级病毒以及其他对抗生素有耐药性的感染正变得越来越常见。
column6: resistant to antibiotics|对抗生素有耐药性的

column1: Geography can often play a very large role in the health concerns of certain populations.
column2: 地理因素往往会极大地影响某些人群所面临的健康问题。
column4: play a very large role in|对……起很大作用

column1: For instance, depending on where you live, you will not have the same health concerns as someone who lives in a different geographical region.
column2: 例如，你面临的健康问题取决于居住地，与居住在另一个地理区域的人并不相同。

column1: Perhaps one of the most obvious examples of this idea is malaria-prone areas, which are usually tropical regions that foster a warm and damp environment in which the mosquitos that can give people this disease can grow.
column2: 疟疾多发区也许是最明显的例子之一。这些地区通常地处热带，温暖而潮湿的环境有利于能将疟疾传给人的蚊虫生长。
column7: warm and damp environment|温暖潮湿的环境

column1: Malaria is much less of a problem in high-altitude deserts, for instance.
column2: 相比之下，在高海拔沙漠地区，疟疾所带来的问题要小得多。
column4: much less of a problem|带来的问题小得多

column1: In some countries, geographical factors influence the health and well-being of the population in very obvious ways.
column2: 在一些国家，地理因素对人口健康和福祉的影响表现得十分明显。
column6: in very obvious ways|以十分明显的方式

column1: In many large cities, the wind is not strong enough to clear the air of the massive amounts of smog and pollution that cause asthma, lung problems, eyesight issues and more in the people who live there.
column2: 许多大城市的风力不足以吹散空气中大量的烟雾和污染物，当地居民因而出现哮喘、肺部疾患、视力问题等。
column3: clear the air of|清除空气中的

column1: Part of the problem is, of course, the massive number of cars being driven, in addition to factories that run on coal power.
column2: 问题当然部分源于上路行驶的汽车数量庞大，还源于那些以煤为动力的工厂。
column6: run on coal power|靠燃煤提供动力

column1: The rapid industrialisation of some countries in recent years has also led to the cutting down of forests to allow for the expansion of big cities, which makes it even harder to fight the pollution with the fresh air that is produced by plants.
column2: 一些国家近年来的快速工业化，也导致为扩大城市而砍伐森林。这使人们更难借助植物产生的新鲜空气来对抗污染。
column4: cutting down of forests|砍伐森林

column1: It is in situations like these that the field of health geography comes into its own.
column2: 正是在这类情况下，健康地理学这一领域才充分显出它的价值。
column6: comes into its own|显示出自身的价值

column1: It is an increasingly important area of study in a world where diseases like polio are re-emerging, respiratory diseases continue to spread, and malaria-prone areas are still fighting to find a better cure.
column2: 在脊髓灰质炎等疾病重新出现的当今世界，健康地理学正成为日益重要的研究领域；呼吸系统疾病也还在传播，疟疾多发地区仍在努力寻找更好的疗法。

column1: Health geography is the combination of, on the one hand, knowledge regarding geography and methods used to analyse and interpret geographical information, and on the other, the study of health, diseases and healthcare practices around the world.
column2: 健康地理学将两方面相结合：一方面是地理知识以及分析、解读地理信息的方法，另一方面是对世界各地健康、疾病以及医疗卫生实践的研究。

column1: The aim of this hybrid science is to create solutions for common geography-based health problems.
column2: 这门交叉学科旨在为常见的、与地理因素有关的健康问题寻找解决办法。
column6: geography-based|adj. 与地理因素有关的

column1: While people will always be prone to illness, the study of how geography affects our health could lead to the eradication of certain illnesses, and the prevention of others in the future.
column2: 人总会得病，但研究地理如何影响健康，将来或许能使我们根除某些疾病，并预防另一些疾病。

column1: By understanding why and how we get sick, we can change the way we treat illness and disease specific to certain geographical locations.
column2: 了解人为什么患病、又是如何患病的，就有可能改变我们治疗某些地区特有疾病的方式。
column4: treat illness and disease|治疗疾病

column1: The geography of disease and ill health analyses the frequency with which certain diseases appear in different parts of the world, and overlays the data with the geography of the region, to see if there could be a correlation between the two.
column2: 疾病与健康不良的地理学研究分析不同疾病在世界各地出现的频率，再将这些数据与当地的地理信息叠加，以查看两者之间是否可能存在相关性。

column1: Health geographers also study factors that could make certain individuals or a population more likely to be taken ill with a specific health concern or disease, as compared with the population of another area.
column2: 健康地理学家也研究哪些因素会使某些个人或某一地区的人群，与另一地区的人群相比，更容易出现特定的健康问题或疾病。

column1: Health geographers in this field are usually trained as healthcare workers, and have an understanding of basic epidemiology as it relates to the spread of diseases among the population.
column2: 这一领域的健康地理学家通常受过医疗卫生专业训练，也了解与疾病在人群中传播有关的流行病学基础知识。

column1: Researchers study the interactions between humans and their environment that could lead to illness (such as asthma in places with high levels of pollution) and work to create a clear way of categorising illnesses, diseases and epidemics into local and global scales.
column2: 研究者考察人和环境之间可能引发疾病的相互作用，例如在污染严重的地方出现哮喘；他们还设法建立一种清晰的分类方式，以地方和全球两种尺度为患病现象、疾病和流行病归类。
column6: high levels of pollution|严重污染
column9: local and global scales|地方与全球尺度

column1: Health geographers can map the spread of illnesses and attempt to identify the reasons behind an increase or decrease in illnesses, as they work to find a way to halt the further spread or re-emergence of diseases in vulnerable populations.
column2: 健康地理学家可以绘出疾病传播的情况，并尝试找出发病增加或减少的原因，以期找到办法，阻止疾病在易受影响的人群中继续传播或死灰复燃。

column1: The second subcategory of health geography is the geography of healthcare provision.
column2: 健康地理学的第二个分支是医疗服务供给地理学。

column1: This group studies the availability (or lack thereof) of healthcare resources to individuals and populations around the world.
column2: 这个分支研究世界各地的个人和人群能够获得哪些医疗卫生资源，以及哪些资源无法获得。

column1: In both developed and developing nations there is often a very large discrepancy between the options available to people in different social classes, income brackets, and levels of education.
column2: 无论发达国家还是发展中国家，不同社会阶层、收入档次和受教育程度的人，在获得医疗服务的选择上往往存在很大差距。
column3: developed and developing nations|发达国家和发展中国家

column1: Individuals working in the area of the geography of healthcare provision attempt to assess the levels of healthcare in the area (for instance, it may be very difficult for people to get medical attention because there is a mountain between their village and the nearest hospital).
column2: 研究医疗服务供给地理的人试图评估当地的医疗服务水平。例如，一个村庄与最近的医院之间隔着一座山，村民就医可能十分困难。
column5: levels of healthcare|医疗服务水平

column1: These researchers are on the frontline of making recommendations regarding policy to international organisations, local government bodies and others.
column2: 在向国际组织、地方政府机构等提出政策建议方面，这些研究者站在第一线。
column3: on the frontline of|处在……第一线
column7: local government bodies|地方政府机构

column1: The field of health geography is often overlooked, but it constitutes a huge area of need in the fields of geography and healthcare.
column2: 健康地理学常被忽视，然而在地理学和医疗卫生两方面，这都是一个需求巨大的研究领域。
column5: area of need|有需求的领域

column1: If we can understand how geography affects our health no matter where in the world we are located, we can better treat disease, prevent illness, and keep people safe and well.
column2: 无论身处世界何处，只要了解当地地理如何影响健康，我们就能更好地治疗疾病、预防患病，保障人们的安全与健康。
